title: Remote autocomplete: Wikidata
description: Backed by the public Wikidata query service over SPARQL, so the suggestions come from a real endpoint rather than bundled data. The dropdown shows the label and description; the form stores the entity IRI. The endpoint is read-only, so no create button is offered: the backend reports what it can do and the control follows.

element.title: Chemical element
element.x-oold-ui-hint: Type at least three letters, for example 'sili' or 'carb'.
